summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Elbit Systems Ltd., a foreign private issuer, announcing the timing of its first quarter 2026 financial results release and a related conference call scheduled for May 26, 2026. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing contains standard forward-looking statements and contact information for investor relations. As a routine earnings announcement, it does not trigger classification as a special situation.
